title: The family fundraiser in your group chat
scenario: A relative shares a fundraiser link for a family in your community after a house fire. The story is real and local news confirms the fire, but the donation page is hosted on an unfamiliar site.

answers.A: Donate because the underlying emergency is confirmed by local news.
answers.B: Verify the fundraiser through the affected family, a known organizer, or a recognized fundraising platform before donating.
answers.C: Donate directly to a verified local organization helping the family instead of using the shared link.

explanation: Real tragedies are often reused in fake fundraising pages. Verify where the money goes, not only whether the event happened.
proTip: True story, false collection page is still fraud.
